description: Retrieves a Trello list by its unique ID, optionally including details for its cards and parent board.

board.description: Determines whether the board object the list belongs to is returned. Set to 'true' to include board details or 'false' to omit them.
board.title: Board

board_fields.description: Specifies the fields for the board to be returned if 'board' is 'true'. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of board fields: closed, dateLastActivity, dateLastView, desc, descData, idOrganization, invitations, invited, labelNames, memberships, name, pinned, powerUps, prefs, shortLink, shortUrl, starred, subscribed, or url.
board_fields.title: Board Fields

card_fields.description: Specifies the fields for cards to be returned if 'cards' is not 'none'. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of card fields: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, or url.
card_fields.title: Card Fields

cards.description: Determines whether cards are returned as part of the list data. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.
cards.title: Cards

fields.description: Specifies the fields for the list itself to be returned. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of list fields: closed, idBoard, name, pos, or subscribed.
fields.title: Fields

idList.description: The ID of the Trello list to retrieve.
idList.title: Id List

name: get_lists_by_id_list

CardLimitInfo.description: Card limit information for open or total cards per list.

disableAt.description: Number at which the limit will be disabled.
disableAt.title: Disable At

warnAt.description: Number at which a warning will be shown.
warnAt.title: Warn At

CardLimitInfo.title: CardLimitInfo

openPerList.description: Open cards per list limit information.
openPerList.title: Open Per List

totalPerList.description: Total cards per list limit information.
totalPerList.title: Total Per List

filter.description: Whether the list has a filter applied.
filter.title: Filter

board.description: The board object the list belongs to, returned when 'board' parameter is 'true'.
board.title: Board

cards.description: Array of cards in the list, returned when 'cards' parameter is not 'none'.
cards.title: Cards

color.description: The color assigned to the list, if any.
color.title: Color

creationMethod.description: The method used to create the list, if available.
creationMethod.title: Creation Method

id.description: The unique identifier of the list.
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the list belongs to.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idOrganization.description: The ID of the organization the list's board belongs to.
idOrganization.title: Id Organization

limits.description: Limit information for the list, containing card limits.
limits.title: Limits

nodeId.description: The ARI node identifier for the list.
nodeId.title: Node Id

pos.description: The position of the list on the board used for ordering.
pos.title: Pos

softLimit.description: The soft limit value for the list, if set.
softLimit.title: Soft Limit

subscribed.description: Whether the current user is subscribed to the list.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

type.description: The type of the list, if applicable.
type.title: Type

ListLimits.description: Limit information for the list, containing card limits.
ListLimits.title: ListLimits
